verdicts.reason: A: in the skyscraper the 'MERRY DISCOUNT' title is small and sits in the middle of the canvas instead of leading, the characters are jammed together at the bottom, and the lower monsters touch the bottom edge. Still, the stack is spread fairly evenly and the bell, heart and red monster each have space around them. B: has the same small mid-canvas title, but the heart, bell and red monster bump into each other at the top, there is a big dead gap between the ghost and the bottom cluster, and the bottom characters are crammed against the edge.
